_comment: Codex hook configuration for the transboarded project root. Hook commands are project-root relative, and Codex runs them with the session cwd as their working directory, so they resolve whenever this file is the loaded project config.
_comment_launch_directory: Start Codex from the repository root, the directory holding .agentic/. A host that locates its project config relative to the launch directory finds nothing when started in a subdirectory, which registers no hooks at all and leaves every guard silently absent for the session - it is not a wrong path, it is no guard. See ../.agentic/hooks/README.md for why anchoring these commands to the Git root is not the fix: it breaks in a project without .git, disagrees with find_repository_root which resolves .agentic/ first, and has no single form that works across bash, PowerShell, and cmd.exe.
